ui.flight.no.stand_now: Better not get up just now.

ui.flight.toast.house_record: The ship's own record is playing
flight.book.title: Flight Log
flight.book.1: First entry. The ice is flat all the way to the horizon. So quiet you can hear the clock on the panel.
flight.book.2: Second entry. The island is where it should be today. I check every morning, though there is no morning here.
flight.book.3: Third entry. I keep the second couch free.
flight.book.4: Fourth entry. Everything is checked. The switches in order, then LAUNCH.
flight.book.5: There's tea in the thermos. When you get home, say you made it.
flight.book.blank: The rest of the pages are blank.
flight.plate.name: LASTOCHKA

line.flightauto.ready.1: All systems are ready for launch.
flight.auto.weightless: Weightlessness. You may unfasten your belts.
line.flightauto.weightless.1: Weightlessness. You may unfasten your belts.
flight.auto.approach: We are beginning our approach to the planet.
line.flightauto.approach.1: We are beginning our approach to the planet.
flight.auto.entry: Entering the atmosphere. Please fasten your belts.
line.flightauto.entry.1: Entering the atmosphere. Please fasten your belts.
flight.auto.blackout: Communications will be lost for a short time.
line.flightauto.blackout.1: Communications will be lost for a short time.
line.hero.flight_liftoff.1: The ice is dropping away. ...I'm really leaving.
line.hero.flight_weightless.1: My hands just float up. Like being underwater, only there's no water.
line.hero.flight_europa_behind.1: Europa's the size of a coin already. And I was just standing on it.
line.hero.flight_planet_grows.1: It keeps growing. And it's all blue. Not a scrap of land anywhere.
line.hero.flight_ocean.1: Just water. Wherever I look... just water.
line.hero.flight_island.1: There it is. Our island. So small... And there's nothing else at all.
line.hero.flight_fire.1: It's burning. Everything outside is burning. ...Hold on, Lastochka. Please.
line.hero.flight_chute.1: The canopy... It's open. I can breathe.
line.hero.flight_afloat.1: It's rocking. Smells of seaweed. There's the beach... I can swim that.
flight.diary.stamp.line: Left the ice aboard Lastochka and came down in the sea off my own beach.
diary.day.flight.plain.0: Flew home from Europa. Fifteen minutes, and it felt like a whole life.
diary.day.flight.plain.1: Saw our island from above. It's the only one on the whole planet.
diary.day.flight.plain.2: Fire outside the glass, then the canopy, then the sea. My hands are still shaking.
dev.action.flight.reset: Flight: put the cabin back on Europa
